name: ufotable digital
summary: Clean two-tone cel figures composited into 3D-laid-out painted sets, with glowing hand-drawn water and fire effects, particles and strong rim light.

traits.line: clean dark lines of fairly even weight; distinct facial expression lines carried from the manga; effects drawn with flowing tapered contours
traits.shading: sharp two-tone cel shadow plus highlight, with compositing gradients and glow laid over
traits.palette: deep blue-teal and indigo nights; vivid effect colours (cyan-white water, orange-gold flame, crimson); patterned Taisho-era textiles in flat saturated colour
traits.lighting: strong rim light, moonlit edges, effect light spilling on figures, embers and glow; heavy but controlled bloom
traits.faces: on-model, sharp eyes with gradient irises and bright catchlights
traits.backgrounds: digitally painted, often built on 3D layouts so the camera can travel through forests, trains and corridors
traits.texture: smooth digital, floating particles, sparks, motion blur, ukiyo-e-like swirling wave and flame shapes
traits.camera: sweeping 3D camera moves circling the action

style_words: Digital anime with heavy in-house compositing, as in Fate/Zero (2011) and Demon Slayer (2019): clean dark lines, sharp two-tone cel shading under glow passes, deep indigo and teal night palettes, hand-drawn ukiyo-e-style water and flame swirls in vivid cyan and orange, floating embers and particles, strong rim light, 3D-laid-out painted backgrounds, smooth digital finish.
avoid: plastic full-CG look where the hand-drawn line disappears
effects and bloom swamping the whole frame
flat TV-cel finish with no compositing depth

krea2.style: Digital anime with heavy in-house compositing, as in Fate/Zero: clean dark hand-drawn lines on every figure, sharp two-tone cel shading under controlled glow kept to the light sources, layered compositing depth, deep indigo and teal night, ukiyo-e-style swirling flame shapes in vivid orange and cyan, floating embers, strong rim light.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as digital anime with clean hand-drawn lines, sharp cel shading and layered compositing glow.

flux3_klein.style: Digital anime with heavy compositing: clean dark lines of even weight, on-model faces with sharp eyes, gradient irises and bright catchlights, sharp two-tone cel shadow plus highlight under controlled glow passes, strong rim light along moonlit edges, effect light spilling onto the figures, hand-drawn ukiyo-e-style swirling flame and water shapes around the light sources, floating embers and particles, painted backgrounds laid out in deep 3D space, a smooth digital finish with the hand-drawn line on every figure.
flux3_klein.recap: Deep indigo and teal fill the sky, the walls and the ground, orange-gold appears only in the flames, the embers and the light sources, cyan-white appears only in the swirling effect shapes and the rim light, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a digital animation frame with heavy in-house compositing, in a signature Fate/Zero style, with clean dark lines of even weight, sharp two-tone cel shading with a highlight tone under glow passes, hand-drawn ukiyo-e-style swirls of flame and mist, floating embers and particles, strong rim light and a smooth digital finish, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of deep indigo and teal night, with vivid cyan-white and orange-gold effect light and crimson.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition wraps its forms in sweeping depth with controlled bloom and effect light spilling across their edges, in a heightened, dramatic mood, keeps to a palette of deep indigo and teal night, with vivid cyan-white and orange-gold effect light and crimson, and reads throughout as a digital animation frame with heavy in-house compositing, in a signature Fate/Zero style, with clean dark lines of even weight, sharp two-tone cel shading with a highlight tone under glow passes, hand-drawn ukiyo-e-style swirls of flame and mist, floating embers and particles, strong rim light and a smooth digital finish.
